title: Practice 7: This week, next month, last year

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: There are ten decades in a century.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.
exercises.context: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place. (DLI, Lessons 73 and 75)

exercises.q: В XV ___ (век) Португалия была могущественной колониальной державой.
exercises.prompt: In the 15th century, Portugal was a great colonial power.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.
exercises.context: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place. (DLI, Lessons 73 and 75)

exercises.q: Белая башня Пражского Града была построена в ___ (пятнадцатый век).
exercises.prompt: The White Tower of the Prague's Castle was built in the 15th century.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.

exercises.prompt: Tom got his master's degree in May.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.
exercises.context: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place. (DLI, Lessons 73 and 75)

exercises.q: Парламент ратифицировал новый закон на ___ (прошлая неделя).
exercises.prompt: Parliament approved the new law last week.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place.» «Note also the expression „на (этих) днях“. When referred to the past „на днях“ means „a few days ago“, „the other day“… When referred to the future, it means „within a few days“.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: НА + Prepositional indicates the week during which an event takes place. (DLI, Lesson 73)

When referred to the past „на днях“ means „a few days ago“, „the other day“… When referred to the future, it means „within a few days“.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: НА + Prepositional indicates the week during which an event takes place. (DLI, Lesson 73)
